verdict.summary: Round 4 remains clean. The soft-branch lowering preserves per-path scope, including converging OPTIONAL/NOT EXISTS targets, nested required components, cycles, and projection exclusion for variables bound only inside negation. The focused tests exercise those load-bearing cases on emitted SPARQL rather than mocks. The query handoff state machine also preserves the intended mount-race and later workspace-switch behavior with non-vacuous transition tests. I found no new correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue in the changed files.
